question.text:
In an experiment, electrons are accelerated, from rest, by applying a voltage of $500 \mathrm{~V}$. Calculate the radius of the path if a magnetic field $100 \mathrm{mT}$ is then applied. [Charge of the electron $=1.6 \times 10^{-19} \mathrm{C}$

Mass of the electron $\left.=9.1 \times 10^{-31} \mathrm{~kg}\right]$
